chapters.subtitle: Evil Time Part 1
synopsisLines: In the heart of Chernobog, a young girl awakens the person within the coffin - the Doctor.
The girl, named Amiya, tries to explain the situation to the Doctor, but the Reunion Movement suddenly attacks them at this time.
Dobermann, leader of the rescue team, briefs everyone on the current situation.
During the briefing, PRTS, the logistics management system of Rhodes Island, establishes contact with Amiya and reintegrates the Doctor into the system.
Chernobog has fallen into disarray. Order has collapsed, and Reunion burns and loots the city with reckless abandon.
Despite knowing that they should retreat, Rhodes Island takes action to try to save innocents.

chapters.subtitle: Evil Time Part 2
synopsisLines: The pressure of the looming Catastrophe weighs upon the psyche of the Doctor's team, though a small back-and-forth with Nearl helps ease up the anxiety slightly.
The long journey home continues.
The Doctor's team passes by a clinic called Azazel.
Gazing upon this now empty complex, recollections of the past and the outlook of a desolate future leads many to reflect upon the conditions of the Infected.
From the point of view of an instructor, Dobermann has greater expectations for Amiya. However, she has also acknowledged the Doctor's commanding abilities.
Time is running out, and the Doctor decides to push for a frontal breakthrough.

chapters.subtitle: Separated Hearts
synopsisLines: However, there is no time to rest. More missions await after returning to Rhodes Island.
After the operation in Chernobog, Rhodes Island receives a cooperation agreement from Lungmen. The next destination is clear.
At the quarantine gate of Lungmen District 5, the Doctor's group meets Ch'en of the L.G.D.
They follow Ch'en into the office of Wei Yenwu, the head of Lungmen, where negotiations have already begun.
The purpose of the negotiations is to establish a cooperative relationship between Rhodes Island and Lungmen to deal with the Reunion threat.
In the process, Wei Yenwu proposes a test to determine the military prowess of Rhodes Island.

chapters.subtitle: Stinging Shock
synopsisLines: After regrouping, Amiya learns that Misha has been kidnapped by W. Amiya presses Ch'en for the truth, and the latter finally reveals Misha's secret.
This time, the L.G.D. decides to join forces with Rhodes Island.
Reunion's infiltration into Lungmen is unpredictable and unpreventable, but everyone is clear that the primary objective is to bring Misha back.
Rhodes Island leads the charge, Penguin Logistics backs them up, and the L.G.D. make up the main force. The battle lines are drawn, and the operation officially begins.
Hoshiguma from the L.G.D. Special Inspection Unit joins up with the party.
The chivalrous Hoshiguma offered candid praise for Rhodes Island before charging into battle.

chapters.subtitle: Burning Run
synopsisLines: Amiya seems tired and confused after returning to Rhodes Island. Kal'tsit gives the Doctor a clue about the secret etched upon Amiya's body.
After a brief respite, they are faced with a new challenge.
In the ruins of a satellite city of Chernobog, a team consisting of Meteorite, Frostleaf, and Jessica are carrying out an exploration mission.
Back at the bridge of Rhodes Island, Amiya bids a temporary farewell to her friends from Blacksteel and Penguin Logistics.
In the ruins, Meteorite's team encounters Reunion forces remaining behind in the city.
After reporting in with Kal'tsit, the team continues their mission. Frostleaf notices that there is something abnormal about the temperature.

chapters.subtitle: Necessary Solutions
synopsisLines: Ch'en, who just woke up from a nightmare, finds herself inside the Rhodes Island landship with her colleage, Swire, standing next to her.
Judging from Swire's account, Ch'en had been attacked by enemies earlier.
While quarreling with Swire, Ch'en gradually begins to comprehend the crisis in Lungmen.
As they say in Lungmen, 'everything has gone to shit.'
Swire may not be as bad as she seems, but the situation in Lungmen is exactly as bad as it seems.
After a confidential communication, Ch'en decides to ask Rhodes Island for help.

chapters.subtitle: Partial Necrosis
synopsisLines: Rhodes Island and the L.G.D. officially begin their campaign against Reunion.
Elsewhere in Lungmen, Blaze stands against a squad of Reunion members.
Blaze dispatches of the enemy and groups up with Amiya. With her is GreyThroat, an operator who Blaze seems to have some bad blood with.
Elsewhere, Ch'en and Swire fight side-by-side again.
The old memories that GreyThroat stirred up cause Blaze to have second thoughts.
However, the top priority is to deal with Reunion.

chapters.subtitle: The Birth of Tragedy
synopsisLines: In the core city of Chernobog, Talulah calls out W's betrayal and throws her from the city.
Patriot chooses to defend the core city of Chernobog and awaits the enemy's attack.
Back on Rhodes Island, the Doctor takes FrostNova's body to the Integrated Bioprocessing Unit — and meets Rosmontis, an elite operator, for the first time.
In Wei Yenwu's office, discussions about the situation boil over into disputes.
Questions. Doubt. Blame. Disappointment. Persistance. Sighs. In the end, Ch'en chooses to fight alone.

chapters.subtitle: Roaring Flare
synopsisLines: The daughter of a duke who has abandoned her past lives in seclusion in small village in a remote valley, where she befriends a kind, simple family.
The daughter of a duke follows her heart, but good deeds with good intentions don't always bring good endings. Because the shadow within her will never give up the will to consume her.
In the central district of Chernobog's core city, Sarkaz mercenaries raise their swords against the Infected of Reunion. And Amiya, with Rosmontis, leads her team with determination.

chapters.subtitle: Stormwatch
synopsisLines: Pursuing a case of theft of military Originium products, Bagpipe under the Tempest Platoon arrives at County Hillock, and conducts an assault operation at a certain warehouse from her intel.
Bagpipe and Horn go to the interrogation room at the appointed time, but come up empty. The barracks have kept them out of the loop, and executed the suspect without trial.
Outcast arrives at County Hillock. At the Rhodes Island branch office, she gets to know the barracks' guard of honor, Jane.

chapters.subtitle: Shatterpoint
synopsisLines: Within Londinium's The Shard, the approaching Rhodes Island comes to Theresis's attention. At the same time, Amiya, Siege and the Doctor are bringing their squad in close to Londinium itself.
Outside the city of Londinium, Indra and Dagda launch a surprise attack on Dublinn.
After successfully rescuing the guide from Dublinn, Amiya and the Doctor assemble a squad and set off for a port in the Sudean Borough.

chapters.subtitle: Return To Mist
synopsisLines: Twenty-six years ago, the Duke of Cumberland's manor was host to a dinner party, with the King and the nobles gathered all in one place. It was there that news arrived of Victorian Realmblade, Kyngasycath, the Sighs of Kings, going missing.
The young heir apparent appears before the masses bearing the Sighs of Kings. As cheers fly, the undercurrents stir to life. A storm is nearing Londinium.

Four years ago, the Duke of Stafford incited an armed rebellion within Londinium, and during the chaos, Golding came to the aid of the wounded Heidi. Heidi was insistent on delivering intel out of the city.

chapters.subtitle: All Quiet Under the Thunder
synopsisLines: The Military Commission of Kazdel's airship fires the opening salvo of the war, and Norport Borough, having been separated from Londinium, bears the brunt of the coming storm. Reunion, led by Nine, is also moving towards Londinium with the goal of gathering strength.
Victoria's dukes have begun to respond to the developments in Norbert Borough, but rescue does not seem to be their objective. At the same time, the tragedy in Norbert has begun to unfold.

The Glasgow Gang, under the leadership of their new boss Cador, arduously defends their gym. Golding, under close monitoring, has no choice but to send Molly to warn the Self-Salvation Corps to evacuate.

chapters.subtitle: The Whirlpool that is Passion
synopsisLines: The Military Commission formally seizes Londinium, stirring the nations of Terra awake. The Ursus Royal Guard makes its own presence known in Victoria. Driven away by Sarkaz mercenaries, Hoederer and companions resolve to locate the Lich's Messenger, and get some information.
A Reunion camp is attacked by Victorian soldiers while Reunion gathers the Infected near Londinium. Guard recognizes that the soldiers are already infected.
The Infected Victorian soldiers do not join the Reunion. Before setting out to look for an abandoned medicine factory, Reunion finds the Infected sergeant's shattered body.

chapters.subtitle: Absolved Will Be the Seekers
synopsisLines: The assembled Exemplars confirm their next objective: The Shard. Rhodes Island has formulated their strategy for an Londinium assault. The Lifebone takes flight only to crash land because of a strange environmental interference.
Things take an unexpected turn as sinister red clouds above the Shard cover the entire battlefield. Meanwhile, Manfred prepares to reclaim the Lifebone.
Siege receives intelligence on the Duke of Caster from Trilby Asher, which helps the Rhodes Islanders understand the battlefield and devise their battle plans.
The Exemplars and Rhodes Island join forces to stop the Military Commission from bringing the complete descent of Amnannam.

chapters.subtitle: Dissociative Recombination
synopsisLines: In the final moments of the war, a strong, nameless Infected Cautus walks the battlefield trying to save lives, only to ultimately walk towards a broken ending. Theresis enters the Originium Assimilated Universe.
Theresis enters the Assimilated Universe to fight against Originium's will.
Theresis and Ascalon battle atop the collapsed tower.

chapters.subtitle: Abnormal Spectrum
synopsisLines: The last Yurodstvo gave a crazed defense before his death sentence. Years ago, Mantra once found herself facing the Royal Guard in a scuffle, and now, to locate Raidian's squad, with whom Rhodes Island has lost contact, she once again finds herself confronting the Royal Guard's tracks.

Rhodes Island enters Bresk to continue their search, which attracts the attention of the city guards. After helping the search party out of a tricky situation, Imperial Guardswoman Eloysius Gorchekova informs them of abnormal Infected in the mines, and seeks cooperation with Rhodes Island in investigating the matter.

Raidian leads a team back into Ursus to find information on the Sarcophagus. The miners of the Far Northern Central Mining District kill a Patrol Unit that attacked them, wanting to leave the district. To remove the positioning chips within the miners' bodies, their leader Rankin asks Raidian for help, who is also in the district at the time.

chapters.subtitle: Critical Phase Transition
synopsisLines: Twenty years ago, the Sarcophagus was sealed off to stop the Ursine Army from turning it into a weapon, yet the First Army has succeeded in firing a weapon whose power source seems to be related to the Sarcophagus.

Ursus is thrown into turmoil as its mines dry up. Anatoliy, son of the First Army's Marshal, has contracted Oripathy, and is murdering innocents out of despair, until the Marshal brings him someone who appears to be able to cure the pain of Oripathy: Hierda. She 'heals' Anatoliy.

The Rhodes Islanders arrive at Deity Grypherburg at the appointed hour in search of the Sarcophagus, and are accompanied by Eloysius to the palace. The Generalik and Hierda head together towards Zelgrad—an Ursine city that has opened itself to the Infected.

chapters.subtitle: Darknights Memoir
synopsisLines: On a chaotic battlefield in Kazdel, the mercenaries Hoederer and Ines accept a new soldier with an unknown background— when one W dies, a new W takes his place.
Months later, after a failed assassination attempt, a messenger returns from Kazdel with a mission from an organization known as 'Babel.' In the midst of turmoil, the mercenaries accept their fate.

After taking care of their 'comrades,' W, Hoederer, and Ines decide to split their forces. W and Ines meet first, exchanging words before crossing swords. At this time, the transport team quietly arrives.

chapters.subtitle: A Walk in the Dust
synopsisLines: In the present day, Sesa and Heavyrain meet a mysterious guest while on assignment in Sargon, and the whole affair is not without ties to a struggle in the Ibut region over twenty years ago.

22 years ago, a Columbian company has secretly sent a prototype sample to Sargon, thus drawing powers from all sides in. Kal'tsit protects the sole survivor, Elliot, and they set out on a journey together.

In a nameless Ursus village, a mysterious doctor performs emergency surgery on an acute Oripathy sufferer. It is then her past finds her—the relative of a Sarcophagus incident victim, Lillia, wants Kal'tsit to assist with her revenge.

chapters.subtitle: Vigilo
synopsisLines: A sudden crisis leaves the Doctor and Amiya trapped in the Columbian wastelands. Unexpected aid against unexpected plots, with many possible solutions.

A Catastrophe looms. The Doctor steps onto the bridge, as if guided by prophecy, to lead Rhodes Island through the crisis. Kal'tsit determines that though the Doctor has lost most episodic memory, a basic understanding of the nature of Originium still remains.

After the Chernobog incident, the Doctor broods over the events of the last three, breakneck months. Caught between confusion and thought, the Doctor recalls an interesting story with a fallen friend.

chapters.subtitle: Babel
synopsisLines: Theresa is murdered by the assassins. The Banshees sing their dirge for the 'King of Sarkaz'. At death's door, Kal'tsit races back to Theresa's side, only to find everything long over.
The year is 1030. Theresa and Theresis visit the Scar Market to prepare for the founding of the 'Military Commission'. Theresa mentions her dream of building Babel again.
Theresa and Theresis convene the Royal Court sovereigns to formally establish the Military Commission. Meanwhile, with Kal'tsit's aid, Babel also begins its operations.

chapters.subtitle: Ending a Grand Overture
synopsisLines: A gang called Glasgow leaves Londinium, and so a tale of Vina Victoria begins.

Following the close of the war, Speaker Vina must handle the thorny issue of the Sarkaz left behind. But she does not hesitate. The moment she took up the mantle of Speaker, she knew what she would have to face.

Soon after the end of the war, Vina determinedly takes up the mantle of Speaker to protect Londinium's citizens, no matter what the dukes demand of her. In the presence, another name is causing her headache: Millscar.

chapters.subtitle: See You Soon
synopsisLines: Loughshinny boards the Duke of Wellington's ship with the Doctor's help, and finally ends the ducal alliance's stalemate siege of the city as Eblana's purple flames spread onto the city walls. Loughshinny keeps her promise and returns to Tara.

After the ducal alliance enters the city, Ch'en finally locates Reunion in Londinium, now led by Nine. Reunion saves some innocents affected by the war, and also hears a call to rise up and resist from Ursus.

After the battle at the walls, the defeat of the Sarkaz has led to more chaos in the city. Nowell helps Clovisia, leader of the Self-Salvation Corps, save the innocent citizens. He witnesses her death and lets his obsession go.

chapters.subtitle: 时间啊，向前！
synopsisLines: 费奥多尔被赶出圣骏堡，出逃途中与维特分散；希尔达踏过内卫殿后造成的邪魔污染，向费奥多尔伸出援手。
九带领后方的整合运动与清剿感染者的第一集团军对抗，捕获了西尔卡；雷德与另一伙身份不明的队伍交火。
塔露拉拒认这支劫掠队伍为同伴，与米拉娜商议前去救援九一方；第一集团军特种部队屠戮感染者，九和西尔卡决心突围。

chapters.subtitle: Children of Ursus
synopsisLines: Dur-nar points out one of Gummy's strange habits when attacking. Gummy tries to overcome it, but fails.
Her habits are all left by past trauma, and may take a bit of time to fade.
Istina tries to treat herself inside her dorm, but at that time, May knocks on her door to visit.
Accompanying May is Natalya, another member of the Ursus Student Self-government Group.
Zima cannot wake up from her nightmare.
She always has such dreams. She will always have such dreams.

chapters.subtitle: People, A People
synopsisLines: Deity Grypherburg holds a special hearing on the occupation of Katorga by a student group led by Sonya. Zoya appears as a witness and recalls the day when Student Assembly's decided to protest.
At the annual Winter Ball, Natalya meets many kinds of nobles as she probes for information alone. While the nobles bicker over politics, they find themselves surrounded by protesting students.

The police appear as the protests intensify, quelling the protest and arresting Sonya. Before the ball starts, Witte is informed of an imminent assassination plot against the Emperor, only to find the Emperor has vanished by the time he arrives.

chapters.subtitle: Guide Ahead
synopsisLines: As the Legati and envoys of all nations congregate in Laterano, Cecelia, a resident of the outskirts, loses her mother. Her mother's final words: 'Leave Laterano.'
Cecelia's halo flickers and dims before apprentice executor Ezell's eyes—but how could a Sankta so young be fallen?

A Liberi, by the name of Patia, shows up to wrest Cecelia away, but considers herself a protector. She says, 'If you truly care about Cecelia, then don't give her up to the Notarial Hall or the Lateran Curia.'

chapters.subtitle: Hortus de Escapismo
synopsisLines: A ceremony comes to a close. Federico accepts his mission from the Pope, and heads to the hidden abbey out in the wilderness.
Everyone in the monastery has their own plans. Federico and his party, having just arrived at the monastery gates, are blocked by the residents.
While acting independently, Serpilia encounters the local residents. Elsewhere, a conversation about the future of the monastery is unfolding.

chapters.subtitle: The Masses' Travels
synopsisLines: Sanktas living outside Laterano come down with symptoms similar to 'falling' almost simultaneously. The Shrine of Nurtury towers above Laterano, almost touching the clouds. No one remembers when it appeared, but no one questions its existence.

The second Summit of Nations gets underway, welcoming top-level delegations from every Terran nation, from Kazdel to Ægir. However, at a critical moment, an unexpected explosion occurred in Laterano. The newly-created Cardinal Lemuen is assigned to investigate the incident.

After causing an explosion in the city, Exusiai enters a confessional and corroborates the strangeness pervading Laterano, as well as the conspiracy to blow up the Shrine of Nurtury and stop the final, most important event of the Summit of Nations—the Nativity.

chapters.subtitle: Break the Ice
synopsisLines: The Doctor and co. accept Enciodes's invitation to Kjerag. After a short recuperation on all fronts, they board the train for Mt. Karlan.

At the Tri-Clan Council, all three clans have knives to each others' throats. With the deadlock unabating, Enciodes proposes the three clans transfer power to the Saintess, igniting a fierce dispute. In the end, the Saintess Enya chooses to accept the transfer.
The Doctor is taken into captivity at the Paleroches'. Enciodes and Gnosis break off relations. Undercurrents rush through all sides, and the situation turns and turns.

chapters.subtitle: The Rides to Lake Silberneherze
synopsisLines: The statue of Kjeragandr nears completion as the mountain snows draw close. Leto's travels take her to Kjerag, where at the train station she happens upon an invited Victorian Viscount.

Leto and the Viscount travel together and board the train to Lake Silberneherze. Receiving intelligence that something could be amiss on the train, the spy Trilby Asher boards, while Degenbrecher leaps on in search of someone. Let this most thrilling ride begin.

Leto tells the Viscount about her past and he is deeply moved. The Trilby Asher begins his investigation aboard the train, and running into Degenbrecher only makes him all the more certain that something is amiss.

chapters.subtitle: Retracing Our Steps
synopsisLines: On an ordinary day, Kjerag is struck by a Catastrophe for the first time in history.
The three clans initiate rescue operations after the Catastrophe, but they cannot prevent panic from spreading through the population. Enya realizes that Kjarr has gone missing.

Gnosis goes to the Rhine Lab observation station to inquire about the cause of the Catastrophe. Elena discovers that observation records from before the Catastrophe have been altered, and a researcher, Carolin, has gone missing. Just then, an angry Kjerag mob surrounds the station.

chapters.subtitle: IL Siracusano
synopsisLines: Texas wakes up from a dream, knowing that her past has come knocking on her door. Dark clouds loom over Volsinii; the rainy season has come.
Sora arrives at the theater she is to work at next. Leontuzzo finds Texas and informs her about her next assignment.
Sora meets a strange audience member while rehearsing the play. The city of Volsinii grows more and more restless as a banquet between Families is about to be held.

chapters.subtitle: I Portatori dei Velluti
synopsisLines: Nuova Volsinii prepares for the Carnevale to celebrate its first anniversary. While City Hall releases a promotional video and citizens prepare masks and costumes, mayor-elect Leontuzzo is caught in a car accident.

Eirene, president of the Truckers' Union, requested by Judge Lavinia, helps investigate the hit-and-run, only to learn that the culprit is her friend—a truck driver named Sommer. Meanwhile, Lavinia has become suspicious of Demetri, the man who invited Leontuzzo to the banquet.

Nuova Volsinii is currently free of mafiosi, but the famiglie have not given up on infiltrating the city. They're trying to use 'companies' to make inroads into the Truckers' Union. Eirene learns that her friend was the one who, while smuggling for the Venezia family, accidentally injured Leontuzzo.

chapters.subtitle: Crossing
synopsisLines: Leontuzzo has been invited to participate in the Red Wine Championship, an event held in Nuova Volsinii by a Kazimierzian businessman. He watches as Demetri wins, which ends up drawing him into a murder case.
Top sales representative Tosia leaves the turf wars of Kawalerielki behind her and heads to Nuova Volsinii. Here, she begins to reexamine her sales methods and goals.
Despite the workers' opposition, Lupina has no choice but to sell the family winery she inherited.

chapters.subtitle: Maria Nearl
synopsisLines: Maria Nearl, immediately after helping her old friends fix their car, appears on the field of a knight competition.
An Angry Zofia goes looking for Maria, trying to convince her to give up knight competition. Instead, she is convinced to become Maria's coach.
Despite her Uncle's objections, Maria spends several weeks training under Zofia and sees some improvement.

chapters.subtitle: Pinus Sylvestris
synopsisLines: A Zalak with a red tail walks about the Grand Knight Territory. An Infected with a red tail attempts to change lives. A Knight with a red tail—has become a leader.

Ashlock Greynuty's competitor in this match is the infamous heel, 'Brassrust' Ingra. A sturdy cannon versus a sharp axe. An Infected knight versus a noble knight. Future versus past. Just which one will claim victory?

'Flametail' and 'Ashlock' want to recruit capable hands for the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, and the 'Wild Mane' Knight, who's been thrown behind bars, is a fine choice. After Wild Mane carefully observes Pinus Sylvestris, she realizes they possess ideals entirely unlike the other Knightclubs...

chapters.subtitle: Near Light
synopsisLines: The opening ceremonies of the Major are about to kick off. In Kawalerielki, the Grand Knight Territory, a storm is brewing.

Spokesman McKee and the Candle Knight are discussing knight particulars, and Maria is talking with everyone about her sister's duel with Młynar. And in the Infected quarter, the Infected knights are right in the middle of planning something.
Malkiewicz hears from McKee about 'Area 0,' and is greatly shaken. Meanwhile, in a match about to start, Brassrust Knight seems to have an axe to grind with an Infected competitor.

chapters.subtitle: An Obscure Wanderer
synopsisLines: After leaving the Grand Knight Territory, Młynar passes through a familiar place. Although those he seeks are nowhere to be seen, an old friend of his is.

Deszcz the attorney's business trip is heavily delayed by an unexpected vehicle breakdown. She spends the night in a village about to be sold for a rock-bottom price thanks to her own work, and gazes at a starry night sky forgotten by Kawalerielki.

Flametail and Ashlock head for border city Dzwonek and find the Infected currently being provoked there. The only one willing to talk to them is saddled with a criminal charge, and when they meet Młynar along the way, they implore him to lend a helping hand.

chapters.subtitle: Ancient Forge
synopsisLines: A new celebration approaches and Lungmen is vigorously making preparations, waiting for a faceless enemy only known by the name, 'Nian.'

The enemy's arrival brings great chaos and confusion, but fortunately, many passionate citizens team up with the L.G.D. to fight back the enemy. Behind the scenes, the true enemy has already bared her fangs, but in front of her stands the Catastrophe expert, Lava.

In order to reclaim the city from Nian, Rhodes Island and Lungmen join forces to make a desperate move. Just when the battle is about to reach its climax... the director decides to interrupt everything.

chapters.subtitle: Who Is Real
synopsisLines: Lava and Kroos, having been sent to Yan by Nian, save an unlucky Messenger, Mr. Nothing. They take him up on his offer to serve as a guide, and he leads them to Mount Hui-ch'i.
Listening to a storyteller's tale, Lava and her cohorts find themselves in a strange town. All manner of strange happenings lead them to understand they may be in a difficult situation.

chapters.subtitle: Invitation to Wine
synopsisLines: Lee the Lungmenite arrives at Shangshu and opts to stop over at Xingyu Inn for a spell. Meanwhile, Kroos and Mr. Nothing also make it to Shangshu after a rugged journey full of hardship. However, some sort of scheme appears to await them.

Lee suffers an unexpected attack from a Miss Du at the inn he's chosen. With no pause for explanation, the place explodes into chaos, and once the bystanders Kroos and Mr. Nothing recognize Lee, they too are drawn into the scuffle.
After leaving the inn, Miss Du is scolded by the innkeeper for acting out without permission. With the boatman accompanying, Lee leaves for the Liang estate to pay his client Mr. Liang a visit.

chapters.titleMain: WHERE VERNAL WINDS WILL NEVER BLOW
chapters.subtitle: Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow
synopsisLines: Liang Xun, Wei Yenwu, the Grand Tutor, and Ling gather at Yumen in anticipation of Chongyue leaving office. Lee and Waai Fu have also come, following Huai Tianpei's trail. Lin Yühsia finds the body of the Catastrophe Messenger and escorts it out of the city.

The murder of the Catastrophe Messenger throws everyone into a panic. The Grand Tutor points out that Feranmut followers might be plotting to do harm to Yumen. Just as everyone has gathered to discuss the countermeasures, an assassin attempts to take Wei Yenwu's life.

A mysterious thief steals the sword in which Chongyue has sealed away the bestial Sui consciousness. Zuo Xuanliao orders a series of operations to capture the Feranmut followers, and Lin Yühsia runs into Waai Fu and Du Yaoye, who decide to join forces to find the true culprit.

chapters.subtitle: A Death in Chunfen
synopsisLines: After leaving Yumen, Qiubai searches for the remnants of the Shanhaizhong gang. Her chase leads her into their den, where she finds a child. After confirming that he only ended up there because of a misunderstanding, she decides to escort him home.

The villagers are extremely wary of Fang Xiaoshi, who left the village many years ago. In order to protect him from further danger, Qiubai stays behind and learns about a past event from the Clan Elder.
An unexpected mudslide washes away the Chidao outside the village, revealing a nameless corpse. Faced with such a tragedy, the villagers present can only fall into silence.

chapters.subtitle: Here A People Sows
synopsisLines: Nian is entrusted with building the Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities in northern Yan. For the sake of completing this important marvel of engineering, three Feranmut proxies gather in Dahuang. However, unbeknownst to others, this project has other uses as well.

Zuo Le visits Dahuang on official business. Shu, the proxy living in the city, seems to be a difficult customer. Troubles in the fields gives Zuo Le a headache, but also a chance to make a few friends.
The summer harvest approaches, but He Sheng's project does not go well. A bit of advice from Shu gets his hopes back up.
On this quiet summer night, a few youths sit together on the ridges in the fields and share their thoughts.

chapters.titleMain: SUCH IS THE JOY OF OUR REUNION
chapters.subtitle: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion
synopsisLines: Four decades ago, news of the True Lung's death sent shockwaves throughout Yan. One rainy spring night, a prince and a scholar hurried their families out of Baizao.

Blaze follows Leizi to Baizao in search of the truth of her origins. As all of Baizao prepares for the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies, a feeling of unease permeates the city. Blaze visits a small eatery, where she enjoys a familiar dish.

Leizi returns to the Judicial Review Office for the trial of Yu Cheng, a former deputy minister of the Office. Yu Cheng has turned himself in, claiming to be the one who burned down the archives in the scrollery. Yu Cheng's strange behavior leads Leizi to believe he may have an ulterior motive. Leizi decides to review old cases that Yu Cheng once investigated.

chapters.subtitle: Fantasy in the Mirage
synopsisLines: While making her way back to the Tianshi Bureau for study, Lin Qingyan receives a letter from Zuo Le, asking her to investigate Yun Qingping's disappearance. Doing so, however, gets her sucked into a strange little town, and a different, utterly baffling case involving the theft of a secret tome of martial arts.

At Mr. Pu's school, Lin Qingyan encounters talking brooms, walking scrolls... and finding out the truth of this town from Mr. Pu, she pieces together that in the fight for the secret tome, an altogether greater mess is brewing for Mangshan Town.

While investigating a robbery, Lin Qingyan retrieves a stone for a dying old man, one that has accompanied him his entire life. After losing and regaining the stone, the old man thinks back on his fated encounters with that collector, scattered throughout his life.

chapters.subtitle: First of A Thousand Autumns
synopsisLines: After the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies, strange phenomena manifest around Yan. The True Lung makes an agreement with the Grand Commandant and sets the day of the full moon as the deadline before which Yan will send troops to quell the Sui. Zuo Le leaves the Garden of Grotesqueries, hurrying back to Baizao with a token in hand. At the same time, Ch'en enters a dream woven by the Feranmuts.

Faced with her past and the Feranmut crisis before her, Ch'en refuses to stay uninvolved. The Grand Tutor's sudden visit deepens the wedge between Ch'en and Wei Yenwu, and Ch'en leaves unhappy. When she returns, Wei Yenwu has vanished without a trace.

Zuo Le runs into danger, and Mo Yi lends a hand, but she also takes the chance to snatch the strange token from him. Ch'en passes through a sentry post, and rescues a woman under attack by geists. Scriptgeists pour into the city, sending it into turmoil.

chapters.subtitle: Mansfield Break
synopsisLines: A mystery individual invites Silence and Mayer to a bar. They find Muelsyse, head of the Ecological Section, waiting for them. She wants to bargain for information about a prison break.
Kafka enters the prison and successfully locates her target, Anthony. But she still needs to find a way to establish a relationship with him.
Muelsyse seems more interested in another character in Anthony's orbit, Robin, than she is in Kafka, so Silence switches the focus of the story.

chapters.subtitle: Dorothy's Vision
synopsisLines: Back in the city at Rhine headquarters, Muelsyse, after connecting with Saria, finds herself pursued. Meanwhile, back at the test site, Ptilopsis falls into the Pioneers' trap and finds herself kidnapped.

The Doctor and Mechanist go into the alley to investigate Muelsyse's disappearance, only to find themselves ambushed. Outside the city, the Pioneers seek to bargain hostages for their freedom. They fail.

Saria shows up and saves the Doctor, at which point the three Rhodes Islanders are shocked to discover the power armor that attacked them had no pilot. Outside the city, the Pioneers receive a stern answer from Ferdinand.

chapters.subtitle: Lone Trail
synopsisLines: Loken is released from prison, Ferdinand returns, Ho'olheyak and Muelsyse battle each other, Kal'tsit joins the fray, and a shooting star falls to the ground. It's about to rain in Trimounts.

Ho'olheyak hurries to retrieve something before the military can. Muelsyse seeks Rhodes Island's cooperation. Saria accompanies the Tin Man. Silence infiltrates the locked-down district. The story that Ifrit tells seems to be portending something.

Blake negotiates with the Vice President and makes a risky decision. Saria and the Tin Man analyze Control's objective. Silence is saved by the Director of the Human Resource Investigation Section, Jara. In a gloomy building, Nasti mutters a few words.

chapters.subtitle: Unrealized Realities
synopsisLines: Two years after the Trimounts Incident, all eyes are on Air Expo Columbia, about to open aboard the Propeller Paradise experimental park. The park's administrator, Gordon Tannen, is promoted to Chief Executive when tickets go on sale. As for Rhine Lab, origin of the 'sky fever' phenomenon, the company is preparing to perform some unremarkable technical checks.

Gordon Tannen's secretary finds Nasti and requests that Rhine Lab skip the pre-exhibition technical inspections. The two sides come to a compromise, and Nasti agrees to perform the inspections in the order that Tannen requested. Meanwhile, assistant researcher Sky Jagger shuts down a company by the name of Lucky Cystybeast.

Lucky Cystybeast's owner goes to cancel his registration, but a staff member guides him to a mysterious phone number. A man reports to Gordon Tannen, claiming to be a guide by the name of Oakley, but there is already another guide by the same name on Propeller Paradise.

chapters.subtitle: 昨日海
synopsisLines: 伊比利亚人重新聚集于海岸，黄金时代的旧都——雷亚-伊比利亚的中心城区打捞在即。克莱门莎和卡门出席启动仪式，而暗处，深海教徒也在行动。
惩戒军德鲁莎对打捞中心的技术工产生了怀疑。另一边，新官上任的克莱门莎意识到岛民与伊比利亚人之间的矛盾不容小觑。
德鲁莎怀疑技术工阿奎拉参与了非法行动，纳乔与克莱门莎为其解围。教堂内，阿奎拉的互助会导师露出真身，他正是深海主教奥卢斯。

chapters.subtitle: Grani and the Knights' Treasure
synopsisLines: Dewville, a remote mountainous village that had become turbulent due to legends of buried treasure, ushers in the arrival of a dashing member of the Victorian Mounted Police: Grani. After rescuing Carol, who was being tortured by bounty hunters, Grani makes a pledge to aid Dewville through their plight.
Carol and Grani discuss information about the treasure in detail while hiding from their pursuers in the attic, but Carol didn't disclose the entire story. Suddenly, someone flies by the window?!

A mysterious operator from Rhodes Island, in search of 'her,' crosses swords with the bounty hunters. Grani decides to leave the attic, but unexpectedly runs into some bounty hunters who are also in hiding.

chapters.subtitle: Under Tides
synopsisLines: Late at night, Skadi realizes Specter has disappeared from her treatment ward, and it is none other than Specter's old leader, Gladiia, who has taken her. Before departing, Gladiia tells Skadi that they will be heading for a small town in Iberia.

Skadi receives guidance from her contact, disguises herself as a wandering singer, and prepares to infiltrate Sal Viento. But her eyes are not alone on Sal Viento, as Iberia's Inquisitors are watching too.
A strange group inhabits this city of ruin. They treat Skadi, a rare outsider, both coldly and warily. A clash ensues.

chapters.subtitle: Stultifera Navis
synopsisLines: Gran Faro, seaside town—a rare sight these days. Rhodes Islanders, Iberians, and even Alive Until Sunset all gather here. A storm is brewing.
Even in death, a Sea Terror still tries to observe the land. Everyone who witnesses it realizes that Gran Faro has fallen into a terrible crisis.
Kal'tsit finally rendezvouses with Elysium, and meets the members of AUS. At the same time, the death of the Sea Terror has mobilized its deformed kin, causing the entire town to descend into terror.

chapters.subtitle: Path of Life
synopsisLines: Milliarium, an Ægirian city, takes the initiative in contacting land, inviting envoys from Iberia to the sea. In order to resolve the Seaborn issue, Ægir plans to open a Waterway to connect the ocean and dry land. At the same time, Ulpianus appears in a nearby stretch of sea.
The Iberian mission and the Abyssal Hunters arrive at the underwater city of Milliarium. Jordi and Irene find themselves in a strange environment and civilization.
Skadi and Specter take the Doctor around the city. Consul Clementia meets with Gladiia in private. Irene encounters the Sea Patrol and assists with the investigation of a missing data scientist.

chapters.subtitle: Exodus from the Pale Sea
synopsisLines: Thorns tries to escape from a group of bandits who have kidnapped him, but unfortunately, he is trussed up once more, and hung upside down from a flagpole as a warning. Within the den of thieves, the bandit leader Juana's crew disapproves of her recent decisions.

Two weeks ago, Thorns, who had come to Iberia in search of a sword technique, is knocked unconscious by a saltfin, and has an unexpected encounter with Pascuala, who is being chased by a sheriff intent on executing her. After dealing with the Alguacil Anastasio, the pair head to the town of Aarón.

Thorns excavates a grave to find the sword technique he seeks, but is mistaken for a grave robber. Pascuala is also caught stealing. As the two are about to be hanged, a gang of bandits rushes the execution grounds, rescuing them and spiriting them away.

chapters.subtitle: Twilight of Wolumonde
synopsisLines: A conflagration claims the lives of many innocents, and a mysterious group of Infected prepare to make their move.
Folinic and Suzuran bitterly wait for news of Atro, an operator missing in action in Leithanien, but only receive news of a Catastrophe that has struck the region.

After arriving in the Leithanian town of Wolumonde, Folinic and Suzuran encounter the local military police captain, Severin. However, the latter is obviously hiding something from Rhodes Island. During the conversation, the Infected appear throughout the town and start a riot.

After resolving the Infected-instigated riot, Rhodes Island's party is welcomed to Wolumonde. However, the mission seems to reach an impasse as parties withhold information, and Folinic starts to grow suspicious, hoping to find the whereabouts of Anto quickly.

chapters.subtitle: Lingering Echoes
synopsisLines: News of Infected taking a surprise turn for the better comes out of the Afterglow, a district of Vyseheim, Leithanien, where Hibiscus arrives to investigate. Coinciding with famed musician Czerny's farewell concert holding its selections, the noble youth Ebenholz and the wandering Kreide apply to participate in the occasion.
Ebenholz and Kreide's performance does not gain Czerny's favor. Consequently, Ebenholz leaves to visit Gertrude, concert sponsor, where he learns of a plan she's had waiting in the wings.
Ebenholz and Kreide begin to rehearse for the concert. Hibiscus is conducting her investigation all over the Afterglow, looking to find the truth of the Infected suddenly recovering.

chapters.subtitle: Zwillingstürme im Herbst
synopsisLines: With Das Kaiserinnensfest looming, Sturmland-Kurfürst Werner von Hochberg is assassinated in his own spire. After years estranged, Viviana returns to her hometown and gets to know Cora, an old friend of her parents, yet loses her chance to see her father Werner one last time.

Viviana meets Empress Ewigegnade and learns that her father's murder is related to the Witch King's remnants, who have also stolen a copy of the Güldenesgesatz. She takes on the responsibility of investigating the case as an Empresses' Voice.

A well-known painter dies after finishing a work titled 'Death of the Witch King.' Viviana runs into Arturia in front of the painting. The art gallery is attacked, and the Gendarmerie captain discovers it is Federico's doing as he pursues Arturia.

chapters.subtitle: What the Firelight Casts
synopsisLines: In a Taran district where tensions flare higher with each passing day, Reed takes it upon herself to save two refugees' lives.

Intending to avoid drawing attention, Reed prepares to leave the Taran refugees being pursued by the patrol. Meanwhile, on the trail of Dublinn's course, Bagpipe and Ch'en encounter some unusual Dublinn soldiers.
Within the deceasd Dublinn soldiers, Bagpipe recognizes the Arts she saw before at County Hillock. With a plea from Fionn, Reed agrees to escort the Taran refugees in their escape from capture.

chapters.subtitle: When Elegies Are Ashes
synopsisLines: In a dilapidated inn, a writer tells a fragmented tale: the greedy red dragon rouses the long-dead Exiled King, while her noble sister leads her companions back to the capital of Tara, Na Saoirsí.

Na Saoirsí is caught up in the Samhain celebrations, but Loughshinny senses that something is amiss. A statue, a 'feast', and barely hidden hatred... What she encounters drives her to meet her sister. Both of them look down at the city engulfed in violet flames.

After a falling-out with her sister, Loughshinny fails in her attempt to dispel the violet flames. Brigid wants to leave the city and go elsewhere, but gets stuck outside its gates. Dublinn, who should be upholding order in the city, only exacerbates the crisis.

chapters.titleMain: 直到大地变成一颗酸橙
chapters.subtitle: 直到大地变成一颗酸橙
synopsisLines: 带着将丢件的罗德岛解密器补送到大涌泉镇的任务，安洁莉娜出发来到了雷姆必拓。但在帮助她联络当地办事处时，接线员塔妮的工作似乎遇到了一些问题。
大断连让现在才送到的解密器毫无用处，安洁莉娜因而决定自行前往南境拿回数据。从未离开过大涌泉镇的塔妮希望跟安洁莉娜一起去南境。
生日当天，怀揣梦想打算出发的塔妮未能得到家人的理解，一气之下离家出走。安洁莉娜外出寻找，却撞上一群来者不善的黑衣人。怎么办？先上路再说！

chapters.subtitle: Heart of Surging Flame
synopsisLines: The annual Obsidian Festival has just begun! Enjoy the festivities, and support your favorite artist!
A party of Rhodes Island members arrives at the tourist city of Siesta, and everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.
Just when the Doctor is about to surrender to the merriment, an urgent message arrives...
Provence and Skyfire head to the foot of a volcano for a field trip, but notice there's something rather unusual about the volcano.
However, before they can get a better grasp of the situation, they hear a call for help.

chapters.subtitle: The Great Chief Returns
synopsisLines: En route to Gavial's homeland, the Rhodes Island aircraft comes under surprise attack.
Gavial and Ceobe wake the Doctor and the three go to the crash site, only to find it surrounded.
After the fight, Gavial realizes she is up against the minions of an old acquaintance. Then, the aircraft's engine is stolen.
That's when Tomimi, a girl who worships the ground Gavial walks on, appears. The party decides to split up.
On the way, Tomimi explains the local situation to the Doctor.
At the same time, an argument over tails catches Gavial's attention.

chapters.subtitle: Dossoles Holiday
synopsisLines: Fumizuki arranges matters such that Ch'en and Lin Yühsia bump into each other in the Bolívarian city of Dossoles. There, the city's mayor introduces the duo to a guide named Ernesto and gives them a mission.

Ch'en is eager to take part in the competition, but finds out from Ernesto that Lin Yühsia got into a fight. She hurries after, but together with Lin Yühsia, mistakenly enters a championship prelim arena.
Ch'en and Lin Yühsia decide to join the competition as a team. Elsewhere, Hoshiguma and Swire have come to Dossoles too.
In an arms shop, Ernesto explains to the two the specifics of how the championship runs.

chapters.subtitle: Ideal City: Endless Carnival
synopsisLines: Gavial and Eunectes, both at Rhodes Island, receive a letter left behind by Tomimi, who is back home on vacation. Supposedly, a Durin from underground brought news that the entire rainforest could be in danger.
Led by the architect Stitch, Tomimi and company head to the underground city of Zeruertza and witness a Durin water slide. Meanwhile, Gavial and Eunectes are searching for their own way underground.
The Durins are celebrating an extra-long summer thanks to the damage done to their dome. Stitch tells the climate representative, come to ask him to repair the dome, that he's found some new helpers.

chapters.titleMain: SO LONG, ADELE: HOME AWAY FROM HOME
chapters.subtitle: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home
synopsisLines: Swire and Snowsant arrive in Siesta only to realize that their vehicle is being followed, so they force Enis to take them out on a 'joyride' to shake the pursuer. However, Bison meets them where their vehicle breaks down, saying that he's been waiting for them. In the Volcano Museum, Eyjafjalla sees a relic left behind by her parents and meets their old friend and curator, Keller.

Bidding opens on the Siestan Fashion Street and unfinished plate rebuilding project. Bison and Swire trade verbal blows in the negotiations. Eyjafjalla makes unexpected friends, including Kahn, her mother's former student, and a strange creature that can talk.

Dolly takes Eyjafjalla to the midnight gathering of the Little Black Sheep, and asks her to retrieve three items lost in Siesta, promising an answer in return. Bison and Swire continue to compete for the rebuilding project.

chapters.titleMain: ADVENTURE THAT CANNOT WAIT FOR THE SUN
chapters.subtitle: Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun
synopsisLines: In the museum of Menat-Ha'mait, Acting Curator Anat and Vice Curator Medjehtiqedti await an honored guest: Pepe, daughter of the Padishah. Pepe has come with the intent to borrow the museum's crown jewel: the Nameless General. But she is unaware that the desert bandit Narantuya has also arrived in the city following her.

When she isn't allowed to borrow an exhibit, Pepe sneaks into the museum at night, placing her gem into the item, only to find it strangely disappears. She is forced to leave when a security guard shows up. The next day, the Nameless General wakes up in the middle of the exhibit.

The frightened crowd flees and Anat faints in shock. Medjehtiqedti helps organize the evacuation, while Pepe, knowing the reason for the Nameless General's resurrection, comes up with an idea to move the mummy and the unconscious Anat to the curator's office.

chapters.subtitle: Ato
synopsisLines: Hoshiguma has only just returned to Mitsukue in Higashi and she is already being chased by the police. In order to avoid them, she barges into Momoka Hanyuu's performance, but thanks to a series of mishaps, she finds herself having become a 'vicious Oni' or 'ghost' right out of a kaidan tale.

Detective Koretou of the Mitsukue police targets Hoshiguma as his prime suspect in a twenty-year-old murder case, but the statute of limitations has already expired. Hoshiguma's return to Mitsukue has nothing to do with the case—it's because of a letter from Tessai, the head of the Kinsekikai yakuza clan, a man like a second father to her. The police are left scratching their heads, while Kouhei Mifune, another Kinsekikai yakuza, shows up at the police station and pulls Hoshiguma out.

Right before Hoshiguma's eyes, Mifune takes a life as if it's nothing. He even forges a letter in Tessai's name. Meanwhile, Momoka is forced to investigate a 'haunted house' kaidan in Kajimachi as part of a new TV show, unaware that it is the very place Hoshiguma once called home.

chapters.subtitle: 丛林症结
synopsisLines: 一名失业后从哥伦比亚返回故乡的玻利瓦尔年轻人，在途经的一座种植园遭遇了“黑流”。
猎犬病防控镇治疗中心里，一位失去记忆的年轻女性决定去寻找自己的妹妹。

chapters.subtitle: Operational Intelligence
synopsisLines: A Rhodes Island operator is rescued by Scout. When he comes to, he happens to Hellagur speaking with Patriot.
Carrying the words Scout left him, the guard also makes up his mind.
W leads a team to intercept a group of defecting mercenaries. Flamebringer breaks through the conflict and leaves Reunion behind him.
At Rhodes Island, Flamebringer will meet another old friend...
Jessica completes her training under the guidance of Liskarm and Franka.
Her skills have always been excellent, but what she lacks is confidence.

chapters.subtitle: Code of Brawl
synopsisLines: Over a game of cards at a bar, two aggressive Sicilians, Capone and Gambino, provoke the ire of Lungmen's most notorious hotel owner.

Bison, a young messenger, is attacked by the Siracusan Mafia, but Exusiai and Croissant from Rhodes Island come to his rescue. Elsewhere in an abandoned alley, the enemy falls into Emperor's overblown trap.

Bison, who was taken back to the base, is forced to accept Penguin Logistics' 'excellent corporate culture.' However, in the midst of the chatter, Exusiai accidentally sets off a bomb left behind by the enemy...

chapters.subtitle: Stories of Afternoon
synopsisLines: Vanilla drags Melantha and Steward with her to take care of her pet, and along the way, they see Blaze with a young Infected girl.
Between them, the Operators decide that after their mission, they would visit to the child who is now receiving treatment and throw a party.
Ptilopsis is writing in her diary. She always uses the diary as a way to record things she doesn't want to forget.
Except now, she would prefer to directly chat with those who she cares about.
Matterhorn obeys SilverAsh's instructions, staying home alone to prepare Cliffheart's lunch.
Matterhorn also prepares a portion for Ethan, who often comes by to scavenge, but does not expect Ethan to come bearing a surprise for him as well.

chapters.subtitle: Rewinding Breeze
synopsisLines: Surtr and Meteorite arrive at the site of their mission, a remote mining community called Bellony Village.
In addition to their mission for Rhodes Island, Surtr is also searching for leads on her past.

Arene needs a certificate from the workshop, but the only one there is the apprentice Adnachiel. Not wanting to waste the trip, Arene asks his fellow Sankta to inspect his weapon, and the two get into a discussion about their race.
Elysium discusses a traditional Yan festival with Purestream, and the two bump into Absinthe seeking weapon maintenance advice from Thorns. During the conversation, Elysium recalls his homeland.

chapters.subtitle: Beyond Here
synopsisLines: Hoshiguma hops onto her beloved motorcycle for the first time in a while, spending one of her precious vacation days enjoying the wind, until she comes to a surprising encounter at the end of the road.
In the wilderness of the Siracusan midwest, three young men, freshly escaped from the city and driving a stolen car, embark on a new journey.
Fulfilling a twenty-year-old promise, Iris sets out to find a particular individual. Along the way, she comes across a tiny, little Oripathy patient.

chapters.subtitle: Preluding Lights
synopsisLines: Two Chernobog survivors leave Ursus for the wastelands, seeking out the legendary 'Rusthammers.' However, in the wastelands, things are rarely that simple.
Heavyrain, in a rush, collapses on the border of Minos. Upon awakening, she meets a Minoan priestess, 'Pallas'.

Bena finds Annie watching Kirara play games, and out of curiosity, Bena joins in too. Upon learning that the game is based on ghost stories, Bena tells a Victorian 'ghost story' of her own to give Kirara a scare.

chapters.subtitle: A Light Spark in Darkness
synopsisLines: Susie, an Infected, works at the shop 'Green Spark' in the Victorian town of Caladon. Just as her dreams are about to come true, an accident extinguishes all her hope.

The vigilante Haze overhears some information not meant for her, and inadvertently gets a store burned down during her escape. She talks Susie out of suicide, but then passes out as her Oripathy flares up.
Skyfire attends an event in place of a councilor, but gets caught in a kidnapping. Realizing there's a plot driving the enemy, she casts to put a stop to it.

chapters.subtitle: To Be Continued
synopsisLines: Following the Snowcap Incident, Sciurus and Yucatan go to Victoria to represent the Browntails, and attempt to make a deal with a local magnate to rejuvenate their clan.

The day before leaving Shu for the capital, Liang Xun finally has a chance at a date with Ning Ciqiu for tea and a play in the mountains. Meanwhile, Du Yaoye, Zuo Le and others are about to set off on their own respective journeys.

Lungmen has welcomed a great number of outsiders. A wolf pack, a pack leader, a lone wolf... Slowly and quietly, they all find themselves shaped by the concrete jungle... until it is time for them to heed the call of the wild.

chapters.titleMain: THE BLACK FOREST WILLS A DREAM
chapters.subtitle: The Black Forest Wills A Dream
synopsisLines: Magallan applies for a permit to enter the icefield as per usual, but finds that Ursus has abruptly blocked the route. She makes her way through Sami instead, meets her old friend Santalla by an old tree, and hears from different sides about the grudges between Ursus and Sami.

Magallan encounters a supernatural phenomenon in the Fjal Vetrtonn and finds herself rescued by an unfamiliar Sarkaz. The Mountains' Sami are extremely wary of the group and chase them away from their defensive line.

The gang stops at the settlement of a friendly forest tribe and stays overnight. That night, Magallan dreams of herself becoming the prey of a shadow. Santalla helps the tribe conduct a ritual that rouses their clan tree, which rises to begin its journey with its subjects, casting a shadow that Magallan finds somewhat familiar.

chapters.titleMain: COME CATASTROPHES OR WAKES OF VULTURES
chapters.subtitle: Come Catastrophes or Wakes of Vultures
synopsisLines: While on a mission in eastern Columbia, Jessica finds herself separated from the rest of her team. In the blizzard, she remembers the special mission given to her by her boss, 'Clip' Cliff: she must find a man named Woodrow.

In a mountain forest, an old hunter rescues Jessica from the jaws of a beast and takes her to Davistown, the designated site of her mission. At the same time, Jessica's teammates are heading towards the same place, harboring concerns for her safety.

Jessica follows the hunter to the diner, where she learns that the target for her special mission is none other than the hunter himself. After the team arrives at the plate, Liskarm discovers that the local government is actually under the control of the bank.

chapters.subtitle: To the Grinning Valley
synopsisLines: The transport truck will soon make its last trip. Warmy works with Alanna to prepare their truck to be returned. However, still attached to the truck, she is hoping to delay its return. Almost as if in answer to her prayers, a strange passenger hijacks the truck and demands to be taken to the Grinning Valley.

Alanna contends with the truckjacker and cajoles her into bringing the truck to a checkpoint to call for help, but security officers want to board the truck to check for Infected. She pleads in vain in to protect Warmy, and ends up charging through the checkpoint gates with the truckjacker's help.

The ragtag band of accomplices stops at a nomadic platform for supplies en route to the Grinning Valley. The skittish and terrified Jerry is worried that a certain someone might catch up to him after he skipped out on his engagement, and is equally scared that the security officers from the checkpoint are out to get him. During the wild chase, he happens to find himself hiding with a woman, and the two develop feelings for each other.

chapters.subtitle: A Kazdelian Rescue
synopsisLines: Within the Soul Furnace of Kazdel, a ceremony meant to placate the revenants instead incites their anger. The airship fires its cannons at the Furnace, and fireworks light up the night sky. Nymph, doing her best to look after a furnace node, picks up a talking firework fragment, and in doing so takes on a special task.

Nymph visits 'the Consultant' Pohl's district in search of the revenant pieces. The gangs are fighting over a meteor and are on the verge of pulling blades. With Pohl's help, Nymph recovers the revenant fragment inside the meteor, and Pohl takes the opportunity to resolve a crisis.

A monster has been attacking passersby near some abandoned shacks. Nymph and Pohl investigate the hauntings and discover that it is a colossus made by Mudrock. Mudrock removes the Arts binding the colossus, and Nymph retrieves the revenant fragment that caused it to go berserk.

chapters.subtitle: Act or Die
synopsisLines: It is the last week of shooting for The Death of Lady Dupont, on a Wrankwood studio plate. The Messenger played by Lucian accidentally 'kills' Sir Dupont, but the blood that flows from the actor is not a prop.

The producer Greta Stone insists that Dalton's death was an accident, but the coordinator Shelly believes it is linked to an incident five years ago. Lucian is reminded of a lesson that the Troupe Leader gave him when he was young.

Lucian has long hypothesized that the Troupe Leader may have returned from the dead. The script being auctioned at Wrankwood, with the Troupe's mark on it, and the accident that occurred after he joined the cast, all seem to indicate that he has come to the right place.

chapters.subtitle: Medjehtiqedti Bound
synopsisLines: Five years after the signing of the 'Non-Aggression Pact' between Sargon and Minos, Titi leads a diplomatic mission to Athenius, bearing a Minoan relic.
The time and place for the exchange ceremony have not yet been confirmed. The Astynomos called Lydia arranges for Titi to visit the site of the rebuilding of the First Temple.
Titi successfully resolves the dispute at the construction site. But where is Pallas, who should have been the one to do it?
